International Aluminium Institute (IAI) (2026). Statistics: Primary Aluminium Smelting Energy Intensity; Primary Aluminium Smelting Power Consumption (by region and by country); Metallurgical Alumina Refining Energy Intensity; Metallurgical Alumina Refining Fuel Consumption; Greenhouse Gas Emissions Intensity - Primary Aluminium; Greenhouse Gas Emissions - Aluminium Sector; Primary Aluminium Production; Alumina Production. Online data series, international-aluminium.org/statistics, all-data CSV downloads accessed 2026-10-06.

Nine semicolon-separated all-data CSVs, moved to other-reports/iai/ as iai_2026_<series>-data.csv (alumina-production, ghg-emissions-aluminium-sector, ghg-intensity-primary-aluminium, alumina-refining-energy-intensity, alumina-refining-fuel-consumption, primary-aluminium-production, smelting-energy-intensity, smelting-power-consumption-by-country, smelting-power-consumption). Locators name the data file, row and year. Latest complete year: 2025 for energy and production series; 2024 for the GHG series; 2023 for the by-country power series. Loaded (all industry averages = benchmark examples): smelting AC electricity per t Al for North America (14721 kWh/t) and World (13880), Canada 2023 by-country sum (14745); refinery energy intensity (MJ/t converted to GJ/t) for North America (8.69 GJ/t) and World (9.59) with carrier rows derived from the fuel-consumption series (TJ / reporting production); World 2024 GHG intensities for electrolysis (process CO2 1.4, PFC 0.9 CO2e, stage total 10.8 t/t Al) and refining (thermal 1.5, total 2.4 t CO2e per t Al). _other-values: DC process energy, power mix, other regions, anode stage, sector totals, production. Traps: (1) units are not in the CSV bodies: smelting intensity kWh/t, refining intensity MJ/t, power consumption GWh, fuel consumption TJ (inferred, see notes), by-country kWh/t (inferred); (2) the fuel-consumption and energy-intensity series use different reporting samples: North America 7.27 GJ/t from fuel vs 8.69 GJ/t intensity; (3) the GHG series is per t primary aluminium for every stage, including refining and anode production; (4) column order differs between files (Oceania and Europe are swapped between the refining intensity and fuel files); (5) World in the fuel and power series is "World Reported" (excludes Estimated Unreported).
